description: One dealer's Everroad Score (0 to 100): the number, band and formula version, each category's points, measured-weight coverage (how much of the score rests on the store's own data), every measured metric with its source, and the metrics the dealer controls through its own website that are not on record (for example a posted doc fee or hours in structured data). Slug from find_dealers, or the dealer's name.
name: dealer_score
title: Dealer score
